name: Glaucous-Sanctum
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past crystal cavern networks, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium, dark crystals and geothermal energy are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
